definitions.gloss: boiled greens with dashi broth, ohitashi
definitions.explanation: A Japanese side dish of blanched vegetables, typically leafy greens, soaked in dashi-based seasoning and often topped with bonito flakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{浸|ひた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
お{浸|ひた}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Top the ohitashi with bonito flakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小松菜|こまつな}→小松菜：12520_komatsuna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{浸|ひた}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧だ。
examples.english: Komatsuna ohitashi is a classic side dish.

notes:
お{浸|ひた}し is a classic Japanese side dish (⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧) of blanched vegetables soaked briefly in a seasoned broth. The お is an honorific prefix; the word derives from ⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧ (to soak).

COMMON VARIATIONS:
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{浸|ひた}し: spinach ohitashi (most classic)
- ⟦{小松菜|こまつな}→小松菜：12520_komatsuna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{浸|ひた}し: komatsuna ohitashi
- ⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{浸|ひた}し: rapeseed flower ohitashi (seasonal, spring)

SEASONING:
Typically dressed with ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce), ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧ (dashi), and sometimes みりん (mirin). Often topped with ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧ (bonito flakes) or ⟦{胡麻|ごま}→胡麻：10337_goma⟧ (sesame seeds).

CULTURAL NOTE:
A staple of ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ (Japanese cuisine) and ⟦{家庭料理|かていりょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧ (home cooking). Simple to prepare and commonly included in ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (bento boxes).
